[[Category:Epic catalogues]]
Ceres, the grandest, a goddess of the harvest,
Nurturing and caring, a mother's love the vastest.
Vesta, the vigilant, a guardian of the hearth,
Providing warmth and safety, watching o'er the Earth.

Pallas, the wise, a warrior in disguise,
A strategist and scholar, with knowledge in her eyes.
Hygiea, the healer, a goddess of good health,
She tends to her companions with a quiet, gentle stealth.

Interamnia, the bridge, connecting far and wide,
Uniting distant travelers, a diplomat with pride.
Euphrosyne, the joyful, her laughter fills the void,
A beacon of light and happiness, a spirit unalloyed.

Davida, the artisan, a sculptor of the skies,
Her hands mold and shape, a beauty that belies.
Sylvia, the woodland nymph, a creature of the trees,
Her grace and charm enchanting, dancing in the breeze.

Cybele, the mother, of nature's life and growth,
Her children are the flora, the fauna, and the loam.
Europa, the fair, a princess of the sea,
Her beauty known throughout the belt, a captivating plea.

Camilla, the fleet-footed, a swift and agile force,
Her speed and grace unmatched, a runner on a course.
Patientia, the patient, a steady, calming presence,
In chaos and uncertainty, her calmness makes a difference.

Hekate, the sorceress, a wielder of dark arts,
Her powers mystify and stun, an enigma to impart.
Iris, the messenger, a rainbow in the skies,
A herald of the heavens, connecting lows and highs.

Themis, the just, a keeper of the law,
A presence that ensures balance, her wisdom without flaw.
Kalliope, the muse, inspiring art and song,
Her voice the sweetest melody, to her we all belong.

Thus ends our epic catalog, the asteroids so grand,
A cast of cosmic characters, through the belt they span.
A tapestry of myth and personality, diverse and unique,
A testament to the wonders of the cosmos, the stories we shall keep.[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
